lines.text: *Bzzzzz* *Pop*

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The electricity is back.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I can't believe we had a blackout.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Was that an earthquake just now?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: ... I think so.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Is everyone safe?
We're fine. How about you?

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Things got a bit chaotic due to that tremor and resulting blackout,

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: but everything's fine now.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: How's your search going?
We found them.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: All that shaking...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Was that due to the Massive Object moving?

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Apparently it fired another Ultra Beam.
Already?!
That shouldn't have happened for another couple of days!

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Apparently it has accelerated its schedule.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: We'll need to move faster than originally anticipated.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We'll return to the school as soon as we can.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: We'll be ready for you.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We need to get back to the school.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Miss Marciana, we...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We can talk later. For now, we have to concentrate on getting back.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We have no idea when another earthquake might occur,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: and it's far too dangerous to be waiting in front of the elevator.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... All right.
*Kreeeee*!

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: Emergency alert. Emergency alert.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: All citizens, please proceed to the designated shelters immediately.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Everyone remain calm and proceed in an orderly fashion!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Shelter number 3 is this way!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Check the texts you've received to see the shelter number you've been assigned to!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: The streets... everyone...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: It seems an evacuation order has been issued.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Apparently.
As I gaze at the downtown area,
the ringing of alarms and evacuation announcements echo throughout the streets.
The terrified citizens of the Ark
are hastily making their way to shelters, under the guidance of the A.C.P.U and other Nikkes.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You know...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I realize this may seem inconceivable,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: but it seems like the Ark is really gonna be in for a beating.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Everyone is scared out of their minds.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Both the citizens... and the Nikkes guiding them.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What should we do?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Is something bad going to happen?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Most likely.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: If the Ark sustains another hit from that Ultra Beam,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: it will be true pandemonium.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: No, that's not right.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: There may be no chaos to speak of, because the Ark will be utterly vaporized.
... Marciana.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You asked why you all were chosen for this mission.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: At first, yes, you were chosen by happenstance.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The NERV members needed military training,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: and that just so happened to be carried out at our school.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That's why you were initially chosen for this assignment.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: At the time, we could have gone with anyone else.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But that's not the case anymore.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You've studied and fought together with them,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: became comrades-in-arms and formulated strategies together,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: and now you all have become irreplaceable assets to this mission.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I am not saying this to make you feel good.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You've proven your worth beyond a shadow of a doubt.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We have?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Yes. Don't you remember the Bunker Buster operation?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That's only because everyone else helped us...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But you were the ones who ultimately took down those Bunker Busters.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That was only possible because of the hard work you've put into working together with the NERV members.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Had it not been for you and the resounding success of that mission,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: the Ark would be in even more dire straits than it is now.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Instead of strategizing and formulating an offensive against the Massive Object,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: we would be desperately figuring out how to get the civilians outside of the Ark.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Miss Marciana...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That's why we need you now.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You've come so far in such a short span of time, and we need you to fight once more.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: To protect the Ark. To save the lives of its citizens.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We need you to stand against this threat, to protect humanity's future.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: But... we're scared.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What if everything goes wrong? What if... everyone dies because of us?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That's why we were running away before.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: It's a terrifying thing.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: It's not just your life that you're protecting,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: but everyone else's as well.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: It is an unfathomably heavy burden, enough to make you want to run away from it.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But running away won't change anything,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: and you know that.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: No matter how much you try to ignore the problem, the Massive Object will continue to target the Ark.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We're running out of time.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I understand what you are trying to say, Miss Marciana.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Whether we run or not doesn't change the reality of the situation.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We'll be faced with this heavy burden either way.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: But say we don't run away. That we stay and fight.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: What if we fail?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: What if we fail you?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That won't happen.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Because we're going to put our lives on the line as well.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We will risk our lives to ensure you succeed in your mission.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You and Teacher?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Not just us. Everyone.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: All the other Nikkes in the Ark, including me,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: will do everything we can to protect you, so that you can defeat the Massive Object.
No one will blame you.
Me, us, and everyone else will fight together with all our strength.
We're going to beat this thing, I assure you.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Everyone together...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We'll fight with all our strength.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: And we're sure to win...
So let's go back together.
Zwei, Ein, and Rei look at the downtown area.
In front of their favorite clothing store,
they see lines of frightened people waiting to go into the shelter.
In front of their favorite library,
people move about anxiously, taking books to store in the nearest shelter.
Others hurriedly close the doors of the student's favorite cafe,
rushing towards the shelter in a panic.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: We'll go.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Although we're scared, we know that you'll be fighting along with us,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: and so we'll try again.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Thank you, Rei.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ugh, I don't know!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I guess either way, it's not like we're gonna die alone.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: If we're gonna bite the dust,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: we might as well try to accomplish something before we do.
That's a good mindset.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... I'll try too.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We're sure to win.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Isn't that right?
That's right.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Thank you all for doing this. I know it's a big decision.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: All right, let's all head back together.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Everyone is probably waiting for us.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: All right!
*Zing*

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: You're back!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: We're sorry...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Sorry, Miss Misato.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Sorry to have worried you.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: It's all good.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: We all have days when we want to skip school.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: ... Thank you for understanding.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: Hey!

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: Why the hell are you so late?!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Sorry, Asuka.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: What are you so down in the dumps for?

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: Turn that frown upside down and get ready.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: We've got an operation to take part in.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: There's nothing to be sorry about, and you don't have to thank me.

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: So quit babbling and get a move on.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Gotcha!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hi, Rei.A.

lines.speaker: ce004_02
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Sorry for being late...

lines.speaker: ce004_02
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: ce004_02
lines.text: You're not late.

lines.speaker: ce004_02
lines.text: The operation hasn't started yet.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: N-nothing. Let's hurry and get ready.

lines.speaker: ce004_02
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Uh... Mari.

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Uh... So...

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: What's gotten into you? What are you so flustered for?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: ... Aren't you going to get mad?

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Why would I be mad?

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Did something happen?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: *Sniffle*

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Any chance I can have some of Naru's chocolate?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Never!

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Okay, fine. Let's get ready.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: ... All right!

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Is everyone ready?

lines.speaker: ce004_01
lines.text: Ready.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I'm ready too!

lines.speaker: ce004_02
lines.text: All preparations complete.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: All set here.

lines.speaker: ce004_03
lines.text: Same here.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Narus say they are all done preparing!

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: ce004_04
lines.text: Let's go and take this thing down.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: All right!
Let's go, everyone.
